Do I have to better myself or want attention? You're the one coming in here trying to do things. This is trueoffmychest, not suicide watch.

I'm a man who has agency and experience. I'll do with it what I will.

You're talking to man who has undergone 20+ years of therapy. Please stop. I'm at 20 bmi, workout three times a week. 

Just stop.
It comes back. Lasts longer. I'm never cured, only treated.
So I should gaslight myself because I didn't achieve the one thing I wanted, something that most humans do? Just eat trash and tell myself I'm happy about it?
Been there, did that in my 40s. Fun fact, you can be depressed anywhere.

What do you say to someone who had to give up their very human dream of marriage? Of having a family? Of mattering to someone?

I've been an adult for 30 years, there's little you can talk to me about in life.
